description: Create a new persistent filesystem in a region (can then be attached to instances at launch). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/filesystems.

name.description: Filesystem name (1-60 chars, must start with a letter, then letters/digits/hyphens — pattern ^[a-zA-Z]+[0-9a-zA-Z-]*$).

region.description: Region to create the filesystem in (e.g. 'us-east-1').

name: lambda_create_filesystem
title: Create filesystem
